cryptohome: Abort chall-resp mount on ROCA-vuln TPMs Refuse to create/mount challenge-response protected home dirs (a.k.a. smart card login users) when the TPM chip is known to be ROCA-vulnerable. This allows to avoid the unnoticeable security degradation of the strength of the user data protection in the situation where the code can easily detect this weakness. For the background, the challenge-response protection heavily relies on the TPM capabilities. If the TPM is vulnerable and the hardware-backed secrets can be decrypted by an attacker, the only level of the user data protection is the encryption based on a cryptographic signature of a constant per-user salt - which is significantly weaker than the hardware-backed protection. BUG=chromium:991429 TEST=none Change-Id: Ie6002b763b4e1a80a20cb431a51e4787ba788538 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1740187 Tested-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org>
